description: Check whether a foreground color is legible on a background color per WCAG 2.x contrast ratios. Returns the ratio (1-21) and whether it passes AA and AAA. Set large=true for text >=18pt (or 14pt bold). This is the legibility axis, separate from color-blindness.

large.description: True if text is >=18pt or 14pt bold (default false)

name: checkContrast
title: Check text/background contrast against WCAG
